name: Shanti Gold International Ltd
tagline: Mumbai-based B2B manufacturer of 22kt CZ casting gold jewellery (bangles, rings, necklaces, sets) that IPO'd Aug 2025 - Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 716 Cr (+144% YoY), PAT Rs 50 Cr, ROE ~37% - but most of the 'growth' is a ~40% gold-price move on ~25% volume, at ~35x earnings, with a small rights issue and a sharp promoter-pay hike
business_overview: Shanti Gold International (partnership since 2003, listed 1-Aug-2025 via a Rs 360 Cr all-OFS IPO at Rs 199) designs and manufactures 22kt CZ (cubic-zirconia) casting gold jewellery for wholesalers and large retail chains, and is adding capacity (a Jaipur unit). Promoters Pankajkumar Jagawat and Manojkumar Jain hold ~37.4% each (~74.9% group, nil pledge). Sovrenn Daily News seed (2026-09-02); Sovrenn trigger: 30-Jun-2026 board meeting to consider a fund-raise. ValuePickr thread 224020 ('Shanti Gold / Sky Gold in making') is new and thin (6 posts, uncategorised).
fundamentals_table: Revenue Rs 716.4 Cr (+144% YoY); consolidated PAT Rs 50.5 Cr (moneycontrol cited standalone PAT Rs 25 Cr, +174%); volume ~+25% YoY - the rest is gold price
Rights issue of ~46.4 lakh shares at Rs 215 (19-for-295), ~Rs 100 Cr; record date 6-Aug-2026
Both promoters' remuneration raised sharply post-listing (flagged in the VP thread); token Rs 3.9 Cr / 0.03% stake taken in customer Lalithaa Jewellery Mart
Same promoter/management as Utssav CZ Gold Jewels; peer to Sky Gold
fundamentals_narrative: Shanti Gold screens beautifully on ROE/ROCE and headline growth, but jewellery manufacturing is the issue, not the exception: reported revenue is heavily inflated by a ~40% year-on-year rise in the gold price, with underlying volume up only ~25%; PAT margin is thin (~7%); and the business is intensely working-capital-heavy and gold-price-cyclical. The company IPO'd only in August 2025 (entirely an offer-for-sale), is already raising a small amount via rights, and both promoters' pay was stepped up sharply right after listing. At ~35x earnings this is a momentum/cyclical jewellery-maker, in the same cohort as Sky Gold, rather than a compounder with a moat.
technical_read: Not pulled. Listed Aug 2025 at Rs 199; rallied ~11% on the Q1 print.
sentiment_summary: Thin new VP thread (224020): an intro note (all-OFS IPO seen as a positive, promoter ~74.9% nil pledge, but promoter remuneration raised sharply), a note that the Rs 3.9 Cr stake in Lalithaa Jewellery looks like a relationship gesture, and a question about the shared promoter with Utssav CZ. HighCAGR is tracking both Shanti and Sky Gold into the festive season. No high-conviction call.
community_signal: Early, lukewarm interest; the cohort (Sky Gold, Utssav, Shanti) is being watched as a festive-season volume play, with governance eyebrows raised on the pay hike.
bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. Listed 1-Aug-2025 (Rs 360 Cr all-OFS IPO). Promoter group ~74.9%, nil pledge. Rights issue at Rs 215 approved (record date 6-Aug-2026). Both promoters' remuneration increased sharply post-listing (per VP thread). Shares/stake of Rs 3.9 Cr (0.03%) acquired in customer Lalithaa Jewellery Mart.
bull_case: Very high reported ROE (~37%) / ROCE (~32%) with modest leverage (D/E ~0.36)
Volume growth ~25% YoY plus a favourable gold-price cycle drives >140% revenue growth optically
Capacity addition (Jaipur unit) and a large-retail-chain customer base; festive-season tailwind
All-OFS IPO (no fresh dilution then) and nil promoter pledge
bear_case: Most 'growth' is a ~40% gold-price move, not volume - reported revenue overstates the real trajectory
Jewellery manufacturing: thin PAT margin (~7%), heavy working capital, gold-price cyclicality, low moat
~35x earnings for a cyclical manufacturer with a ~1-year listed history
Governance watch: sharp promoter-remuneration hike right after listing; a small rights issue soon after an all-OFS IPO
Multiple related promoter entities (Utssav CZ) - group-structure and related-party complexity
verdict_headline: High screen-optics (37% ROE, +144% revenue) mostly driven by the gold price on ~25% volume; a thin-margin, working-capital-heavy jewellery manufacturer at ~35x with a post-IPO pay hike and a rights issue - thesis_fit neither, conviction Low-Medium.
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn Daily News seed; the trigger (a fund-raise board meeting) resolved into a small ~Rs 100 Cr rights issue at Rs 215 - a mild dilution/expansion signal, not a value catalyst

Reported growth is dominated by a ~40% gold-price rise on ~25% underlying volume; PAT margin is ~7% and the business is gold-price-cyclical and working-capital-heavy -> the quality gate (durable, real growth) is not cleared -> thesis_fit neither

Conviction Low-Medium: genuine high ROE/ROCE and a festive-season volume tailwind lift it above Low; the valuation (~35x), thin margins, ~1-year listed history, the promoter-pay hike and the quick rights issue cap it there
Not a red flag - the pay hike and rights issue are governance watch-items, not AVOID/EXCLUDE/HIGH-CAUTION triggers - but they are named in the bear case
No live-theme match: jewellery manufacturing is not on the active list (the 'gold financiers' theme is about gold-loan NBFCs, not jewellers); value_chain block added
revisit_after_30d false (conviction below Medium-High, thesis_fit neither)
